observations: Brand 'YAMAHA' is printed above the display area in photo 0.
The unit is tightly wrapped in clear plastic film.
Control panel features a central LCD screen, a circular data dial on the right, and a grid of buttons on the left.
Model name text is present on the top right corner but is illegible due to plastic wrap and photo resolution.
The keyboard is shown leaning against a wall on a tiled floor, not powered on.

claims.evidence: The origin of second-hand imports cannot be determined from visual inspection alone.
Audio quality and speaker functionality cannot be assessed from still photos.

risks.proof: A video of every key being played and major buttons being pressed.

risks.risk: LCD screen failure (blank, lines, or bleeding)
risks.proof: A photo of the unit powered on showing a clear display.
A photo of the power supply unit (adapter).

risks.risk: Hidden cracks or damage under the plastic wrap
risks.proof: Photos of the unit with the plastic wrap removed.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the model name on the top right of the keyboard.
Photo of the keyboard powered on with the screen lit up.
Video of the keyboard being played to hear the speakers and verify all keys work.
response.reason: The specific model number, which significantly impacts the market value of Yamaha PSR keyboards, is unreadable. Additionally, the unit is wrapped and powered off, preventing any assessment of its functional state.
